memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.” Genesis 1:27

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Man is the highest intellectual creation God has ever made, because he alone was granted the image of God. Neither angels nor heavenly beings were given this divine imprint. Man was created as the crown of God’s creation. Therefore, humanity is called to live continually with gratitude, humility, and reverence toward God.

However, this highly intelligent being has failed to fully understand himself. He has taken God’s will lightly and has begun to indulge carelessly in the world. The primary ambition of today’s world is no longer to fulfill God’s creative purpose, but to pursue empty and vain recreation. Time, thoughts, life, and purpose are all wasted in endless entertainment.

To lead humanity astray, Satan has invented countless methods and strategies of recreation. What was meant to discipline and refresh the body has now enslaved the soul. The commandments and laws given by God were not meant to destroy joy, but to protect order, discipline, and spiritual boundaries. Among all human senses, the eyes are the most easily drawn into temptation. What the eyes behold, the heart soon follows. When the perfect purpose of God’s creation is lost from the mind, recreation begins to dominate and enslave humanity.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “The greatest enemy of devotion is not persecution, but distraction.” - Charles Spurgeon

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, remind us of the purpose for which You created us. Deliver us from careless living and uncontrolled desires. Establish and strengthen Your image within us. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: You were not created for mere recreation, but to reflect the image of God. Guard your eyes, redeem your time, and realign your life to glorify Him.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: Knowing Scripture
recommended_book.author: R. C. Sproul
recommended_book.quote: “We bear the image of God, and every action and choice either reflects or distorts that image.”
